rule: At 10 PeV the complex coefficient of the 23,32,33 edges is z=|Vud| exp(i arg S). A separate signed real x multiplies the other edges with the 1,1,3 Clebsches. Calibrate the real x and CKM angle with electron and muon Yukawas only, and solve for tau(MZ), the charged frame and neutral thresholds; compare the uncalibrated tau and independently measured gamma. The original pre-split R1702 one-loop contract is retained as a named conditional test.
